<h3>Cómo se juega</h3><ul><li><b>Encende:
How to play

  • Turn it on: the Halloween button in the menu or on the start screen (in Halloween week, by itself, at nightfall). The time changes to dusk and the Halloween station plays.
  • Trick or treat: walk up to the door of a house with pumpkins and press Knock on the door. A neighbour in costume comes out: Treat gives you 2 to 5 sweets; Trick is a prank and then gives you 1 to 3 sweets for being brave.
  • The pranks: a fright (a ghost shouts «BOO!»), a shower of toy spiders, or it turns you into a pumpkin for 20 seconds.
  • Each house, once a night. If you knock at them all on the same night you win the «Complete Halloween night» trophy. Every 10 sweets in a night gives 5 coins.
  • Costumes: Costumes tab or the shop. The ghost is free.
  • Powers: each costume has a power (the Power button, △ / Y or the Q key): the mummy swings on bandages, the witch flies on a broom, Dracula turns into a bat, the ghost goes through walls, the skeleton falls apart, the pumpkin rolls and the pirate fires out of a cannon. They're explained in the Costumes tab.
<h3>Qué aparece por las casas</h3><ul><l:
What appears round the houses

  • Ghost: comes out of a wall, floats towards you, says «boo» and goes off upwards.
  • Witch on a broom: flies over the roofs laughing.
  • Bats: fly out of a roof in a flock.
  • Skeleton: comes out of the garden, dances a bit and goes back in.
  • Black cat: crosses in front of the house, stops, arches its back, miaows and goes.

They scare you a little (you give a small jump) and go away by themselves; they don't do anything else.
